name: Sentry
one_liner: Sentry offers a REST API for managing organizations, projects, events, and integrations, authenticated via bearer tokens or OAuth2.
auth_notes: Bearer tokens are passed in the Authorization header and OAuth2 is supported via the authorization code grant.
access_notes: Tokens can be created in the Sentry UI as internal integrations or personal tokens.

evidence.snippet: Sentry supports OAuth2 with the authorization code grant type.
You can create authentication tokens within Sentry by creating an internal integration.
